scope: Read-only classification of LON/HCC/DHWC nvi setpoint objects and KM-BUS participant identity blocks on the local VDensHO1/20C2 WB2A.
conclusions: A401/A403/A441/A443 all read exactly 20.00 C. Because M2 is absent locally yet its HCC2 nvi values equal the HCC1 nvi values, 20.00 C is strongly consistent with an inactive/default network-input value rather than a live local controller target.
A401 does not track the configured A1 room target in this snapshot: local 0x2306 was 21 C while A401 was 20.00 C.
A403 does not track the active internal A1 flow target: 0x2544 was 0.0 C while A403 was 20.00 C.

A3C0 was 50.00 C while 0x6500 current DHW target was 5.0 C. Therefore A3C0 is not a mirror of the currently effective DHW target. The configured user DHW target 0x6300 was not sampled in this run and is the correct next comparison.
The internal pump is the only populated pump software-index block among the three sampled pump identities: 0x0A54 is nonzero while 0x0A4C and 0x0A50 are all zero.

HCC_nvi_default.statement: The HCC1/HCC2 nvi setpoint objects are inactive/default LON input-side values on this installation.
HCC_nvi_default.basis: All four HCC nvi objects equal 20.00 C despite different local topology and active A1 values; absent M2 provides a control.

DHWC_nvi_mapping.statement: A3C0 may correspond to the configured DHW user setpoint rather than the currently effective 0x6500 value.
DHWC_nvi_mapping.next_test: Read 0x6300 and compare it with A3C0 in the same window.

HCC_external_room_mapping.statement: A401 may correspond to or feed the external room-setpoint object 0x2321 rather than the normal user room setpoint 0x2306.
HCC_external_room_mapping.next_test: Read 0x2321 and compare it with A401 in the same window.
